label: What type of instance do you want to use? (instance_type)
description: EC2 instance type to provision. This will be used along with vcpus to calculate the number of nodes to provision
name: instance_type

label: How many Virtual CPUs do you want ? (vcpus)
description: Number of Virtual CPUs (vCPUs) to allocate to the simulation. This will be used along with instance_type to calculate the number of nodes to provision
placeholder: Number of EC2 instance will automatically be calculated based on Instance Type and vCPUs count
name: vcpus

label: Input location (input_file)
description: input_file is a reserved name on SOCA. The value will automatically be replaced by the input location provided by the user. You MUST have it and parameter name MUST be input_name
placeholder: (Do not delete) This entry will automatically be pre-populated with the absolute path of the input file.
name: input_file

label: How much storage do you want (SSD under /scratch)
name: scratch_size

label: (Example) What version of the solver do you want to use ? (binary_location)
description: Path to the solver executable/binary. It's usually located within the "bin" folder of your installation directory
name: binary_location

label: (Example) User code to be executed AFTER the solver command (user_post_exec)
name: user_post_exec
